name: Summer Series 2026 course card CC2, Saturday, hut starts

notes.title: Card notes
notes.text:
Marks in red, suffixed p, to be rounded to Port, except Turning (X) to be passed to Port.
Marks in green, suffixed s, to be rounded to Starboard. Restriction around hut - see SI H5.10.
Start line is a transit above the hut, with limit mark orange, black, green or yellow, as signalled.
Finish line is between an orange line on the corner of the hut and the orange limit mark.

notes.title: Marks, bearings and distances
notes.text: Mark positions may vary slightly. All figures are approximate. Warning: Some direct paths are obstructed.
